purpose: Qualify restart/replay semantics with the production-candidate external Ribasim profile: accepted external heads are rebound after restart, never persisted as SWAP physical state, while signed exchange and mass continuation remain identical.
cases: First accepted window uses external head -12.25 cm and +0.01 cm/d signed drainage.
Export and restore committed SWAP state at midpoint.
Unaccepted external head view is rejected before runtime and cannot mutate committed state.
Second accepted window uses a fresh external head +7.75 cm and -0.01 cm/d signed infiltration on continuous and restored routes.
Final committed state and mass results are bit-identical between continuous and restarted routes under O0 and O2.
hard_rules: Ribasim head/revision are interface inputs and are not included in SWAP restart payload.
Exactly-once mass remains owned by the existing transaction ledger.
Restart restore must preserve lineage/revision/time before rebinding the external head.
